caseName: Planned Parenthood of Southeastern Pennsylvania v. Casey
caseNameFull: Planned Parenthood of Southeastern Pennsylvania v. Casey, Governor of Pennyslvania and Casey, Governor of Pennsylvania v. Planned Parenthood of Southeastern Pennsylvania

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 502 U. S. 1056.] Motions of James J. Crook and America 21, Family Values for the Twenty-First Century for leave to file briefs as amici curiae denied. Motion of Arlen Specter to join amici curiae brief of Don Edwards et al. granted.
